prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: hexagonal basalt column tops forming a paved floor, dark grey The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square seamless repeating game terrain texture, dark grey basalt hexagonal column tops forming a paved floor for a top-down JRPG map. Edge-to-edge surface, continuous hexagonal paving across all four boundaries: left edge matches right edge, top matches bottom edge. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, clean hand-placed square pixel blocks at a single consistent pixel grid (roughly 8x8 output pixels per art pixel), razor-sharp hard edges, no antialiasing, no blur, no noise, no photographic texture, no checkerboard dithering. Naturally irregular tightly packed roughly hexagonal basalt caps with narrow dark joints, subtle chipped edges and worn planar facets spread evenly, no focal feature. Pixel clusters of 3–10 art pixels with clear intentional shapes. Rich earthy 4–6 shade ramp per material: dark charcoal/grey basalt, shadow facets hue shifted toward muted saturated purple/red, highlight edges toward subdued warm yellow-grey. Steep overhead orthographic classic top-down RPG floor texture, no perspective. Neutral soft even lighting upper left, calm overcast evening clean base colors. NO cast shadows, night darkness, glow, light pools, vignette, objects, border, frame, lettering. Entire square filled uniformly with floor texture.
